boxes.question: Does the piece focus on an extremely cheap, ordinary object?
Is the piece written in an ode-like, abstract literary style?
Does it use a distinctly ceremonial, almost deifying tone toward the object?
Does it describe details of the object and give them extraordinary meaning?
Does it praise authenticity as something not defined by brands?
Does it subtly critique the idea that expensive goods are necessarily better?
Is the writing coherent and artful enough to make its praise and critique effective?
